Owen: Hey team — opened PR #52301 that implements an adaptive cost-aware routing policy. Need runtime + infra + sec eyes before I can schedule a canary. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/52301 :wave:
Maya: Thanks Owen. Can you paste the short rollout plan here and the merge window you're aiming for?
Owen: Merge target is Wed 11:00 PT with a 2h canary. Rollout plan: enable feature flag off by default, route 10% traffic -> new policy for 30m, then 100% if no regressions. Small smoke tests + latency guardrail.
Raj: I can take runtime perf numbers — what's the perf delta on p50/p95 for 8k seqs? Also does this change KV cache behavior?
Owen: Perf numbers in PR description: +2% p50, +8% p95 at peak (8k seq synthetic). It adds a small async decision layer but doesn't touch KV storage. KV hits unaffected.
Lin: From infra side: does the new policy introduce extra RPCs or long-lived connections? Any resource scaling implications?
Owen: No new long-lived connections. There's an occasional short RPC to routing service on cold routes (~5qps per node). We added retry/backoff. CPU + network negligible in my tests.
Priya: Security quick check: need a brief note on privacy/regulatory impact (routing decisions based on tenant metadata?). If any PII or tenant identifiers used, we should record the justification and denylist.
Owen: Good call. Routing uses only model_id, region, and an opaque tier tag (no user content). I'll add a short sec note in the PR and list the denylist.
Maya: @Raj @Lin @Priya can we get asynchronous LGTM by EOD? If any blocking concerns, flag them here and we can pull into a quick sync.
Raj: I'll add perf sign-off in comments after I re-run the 8k seq job (queued now). ETA 2h. :mag:
Lin: Quick infra note — we need a feature-flag config change in kube-configs repo (namespace: infra-flags). If you can add that to the PR I can approve faster.
Owen: Adding the kube flag snippet now. Snippet: ```- name: adaptive_cost_routing enabled: false``` Will push update to the PR.
Priya: If the sec note is in PR and denylist is explicit, I can give a conditional lgtm (non-blocking) — will do after the update.
ci-bot: CI pipeline for PR #52301: all checks passed (unit/integration/linters). SHA: a3b4c7d. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary window proposal queued for Wed 11:00 PT (2h). Will only schedule after all required LGTM labels are present.
Owen: Thanks all — I'll push the kube flag and sec note, then ping again. Appreciate the quick responses. :pray:
